description: This file defines functions and constants related to handling hexadecimal data, including a lookup table for hex character values, functions to convert hex characters to their numeric values, and a declaration for a function that converts hexadecimal strings to bytes.

methods.name: unsigned int hexval(unsigned char c)
methods.description: Inline function that retrieves the numeric value of a hex character.

methods.name: int hex2chr(const char * s)
methods.description: Converts two hex characters into a single byte, returning a negative value on error.

methods.name: hex_to_bytes
methods.description: Converts a string of hexadecimal characters into a binary byte array.

ctags.name: hexval
ctags.pattern: /^static inline unsigned int hexval(unsigned char c)$/
